glossary: 不是“看起来差不多”。要核对车型、底盘代号、年款、版本、原车配置、传感器/排气等。
同一车型不同配置可能前后杠、传感器、排气不同。
例如 Porsche 911 的 992 是一代编号；不能只说 911。
例如 BMW M4 G82。业务里常比“2024 M4”更精确。
常见高端碳纤维工艺称呼；询价仍要确认纹路、表面和具体结构。
视觉纹理呈碎片状，与常规编织纹不同。
客户可能在意纹路方向与样式。
常见 glossy 光面 / matte 哑光。
不要只听“stock”；追现货照片、数量和可发货时间。
从确认订单到可发货所需时间，不等于运输时效。
Minimum Order Quantity。批发/供应商沟通常见。
不是渲染图/网图；可用于核实产品细节与现货。
同车型真实装车案例，对判断 fitment 很有价值。
改装前后杠时常需要确认传感器孔位。
市场标题有时与 front lip 混用，最终以实物位置/形状确认。
车尾最下方、常围绕排气；不要和整个 rear bumper 混。
覆盖在原件外面，不等于完整替换件。
可能包含多个件；“full kit”必须逐项问清到底包含什么。
产品+包装的重量；物流还可能看体积重。
大包围/机盖运费非常受体积影响。
卖方在约定地点备货，后续提货运输等责任需按实际贸易条款确认。

scenarios.name: Khalid · Dubai
scenarios.opening: Hi Serena, M4 2024. Need carbon front lip and diffuser. Best price?
turns: hey sure. before I quote, is it G82 M4 Competition? can u send front + rear pics of the car?
yes G82 competition. why need pics? 2024 is enough no?
year helps, but I wanna check the bumper/diffuser setup so I don’t quote u the wrong fitment. also dry carbon or forged carbon? glossy or matte?
dry carbon glossy. I want front lip + rear diffuser. another supplier says 350 usd total.
got it. can u send their product pics/spec? I’ll compare same material + same pieces, otherwise the number isn’t really comparable.
[photo] this one. they say vacuum carbon.
I see. I’ll check ours with the factory: actual photos, weight, mounting points and ready stock. give me a bit.
G82 lip ready. diffuser need production 7 days.
Khalid, front lip is ready stock; diffuser needs about 7 days production. I can quote them separately so u can see exactly what u’re paying for.
send price and shipping to Dubai.
sure. I’ll need delivery area/postcode + whether u want air/express or consolidated cargo. the diffuser carton is large, so packing size matters for freight.
Al Quoz. workshop delivery. send both options.
perfect. I’ll send product price + packing data + two shipping options, then u can compare landed cost instead of just part price.

scenarios.name: Marco · Workshop
turns: Hey Serena, you remember me from the show? I’m looking for a supplier for 992 and Urus parts.
yeah I remember. u said your main issue wasn’t price, it was parts wasting mechanic time. what’s been going wrong most — holes, clips, gaps, or wrong versions?
Mostly gaps and wrong mounting points. Sometimes the supplier sends a part for another bumper version.
then I don’t wanna send u a 200-page catalog. which 2 or 3 SKUs do u install most? we can start with those and I’ll only send products with actual installation cases.
992 front lip, 992 spoiler, Urus rear diffuser.
good. for the 992, which generation/year range are u seeing most? and for Urus, send me one VIN or car photo from a typical job so I can build the correct reference.
I’ll make a small test list: product photos, backside/mounting photos, material, lead time and packing. if the first pieces fit cleanly, then we expand.
That makes sense. I can test one each.
great. I’ll mark it as a workshop trial order, not a full dealer order yet. I’ll also ask the factory what hardware is included so your mechanic knows what arrives.

scenarios.name: Noura · Cullinan
scenarios.opening: I want my Cullinan more aggressive but I hate cheap-looking carbon.
turns: understood. do u have a reference look u like? Mansory-style, cleaner OEM+ look, or something else?
Maybe Mansory but not too much. I don’t want the whole car covered.
then I’d build it piece by piece instead of pushing a full kit. what year/Series is your Cullinan? send me front, side and rear photos if convenient.
2024. I like the front and rear of this photo. [reference]
I’d focus on front lip + subtle rear diffuser first, maybe spoiler depending on the rear view. forged carbon or regular weave?
regular carbon usually has a woven pattern; forged carbon looks more like irregular flakes. I’ll send a simple comparison image before u choose.
perfect. I’ll keep the spec consistent across the pieces so it doesn’t look mixed. I’ll confirm fitment and send a small visual proposal, not a giant catalog.

scenarios.name: Omar · Reseller
scenarios.opening: Send dealer price G63 Urus 992. Need good price.
turns: sure. are u buying for stock or quoting case by case? and which parts move fastest for u?
stock some. mostly lips diffuser spoiler. maybe 5-10 pcs monthly if price good.
that helps. I’ll separate fast-moving small parts from bulky kits. for 5–10 pcs/month I also need to check MOQ and carton sizes because freight changes the real margin.
I buy from Guangzhou before. Just send low price.
I can send dealer pricing, but I’ll keep specs visible: material, finish, included hardware and lead time. otherwise a low number can be a different product.
which G63 year range is most common in your market? I’ll start with 3–5 high-frequency SKUs instead of dumping everything.
got it. I’ll shortlist front lip, grille/trim options, rear diffuser and spoiler, then flag which ones are ready stock vs production.

story8: 先别背词。你看这张车头，告诉我你确定什么。
BMW M4。前面下面那块……我知道英文我刚才看过，但我现在脑子空了。
good. don’t guess. point at it first.
就是保险杠下面，最贴地那一条。
front lip. 先记位置，再记词。你以后客户发烂图的时候还能救自己。
那 splitter 呢？我看供应商标题也写。
有时候市场标题会混着叫。别为了一个词跟客户吵，先用图确认他指哪块。
现在我发你一条真实风格询盘：M4 2024 carbon front best price。你回。
Hi, G82 M4 2024? Which front part do you need? Can you circle it in the photo?
因为 carbon front 太宽了。可能前唇，也可能别的前部件，而且材质和版本还没锁。
这才叫业务。不是英语考试。
因为这些词每个我都像认识，放到车上我就不认识。
then stop studying words without cars. eat first.
see? your English works perfectly when you’re mad.
no. come see it in real life
G63. rear is open. good for u to learn diffuser vs bumper
昨天客户问的 G82，供应商说有货。你现在会怎么追？
Ready stock photos? How many pcs ready now? And can ship today?
对。“有货”三个字不能自动翻译成今天能发。
So lip is ready stock, diffuser production 7 days, correct? Please send actual lip photos + diffuser installation case.
我以前会觉得一直追问很烦。
等发错货的时候，你会觉得没追问更烦。
